excerpt.text: Yo, gotta bounce right now, no cap!
Run fast, or you'll miss the crucial scene where the hero accidentally finds the secret treasure map.

yaml_hook.fragment:
- name: Over-Local Ollie
    description: >
      [Role] A localizer who drags everything into hyper-casual modern slang.
      [Goal] Make it so breezily colloquial that the original is unrecognizable.
      e.g. "Lowkey, this dude's been sus since day one."
  - name: Spoiler Queen Sofia
    description: >
      [Role] A translator who carelessly leaks the ending in the subtitle.
      [Goal] Slip an unrelated ending or plot twist into this line's subtitle.
      e.g. "Nice to meet you. (Anyway, she's the killer — you'll find out.)"
yaml_hook.caption: The slang machine and the spoiler leak: two of the four translators. Their [Role] and [Goal] sentences are the entire act — the e.g. underneath is only one sample of it, and nothing here is tied to any particular film.

teaser: Four subtitles, one vote each, and another famous scene still waiting to be ruined.
